_doc: BY-PROJECT dashboard (multi-project breakdown). The product/SRE dashboards show the
ALL-PROJECT rollup; THIS one cuts the project-VARYING KPIs by projectId so ops can see
which project drives usage / answers worst / runs slowest. Cross-project infra health
(alarms, card health, cold start, log pipeline) is NOT here — it isn't project-specific;
it lives on the SRE dashboard as a single shared view.
Reads the projectId-dimensioned companion metrics (…ByProject, from by-project-metrics.json)
via SEARCH('{NS,projectId} MetricName="…ByProject"', …) so projects auto-discover — no
hardcoded project ids. With ONE project today, each panel shows a single series; it fans
out automatically as projects are added. These metrics are SPARSE (dimensioned) — fine for
breakdown panels; alarms still watch the dense un-dimensioned rollup on the SRE board.
TEMPLATE — ${REGION}/${NAMESPACE} rendered by render_dashboard.py. Edit the template (源在 git).
HARD CONSTRAINT: every widget is metric/text — NO type:log Insights widgets (cost).

# source-truth · 分项目看板
按**项目**拆分用量与质量（每条线=一个项目，自动发现）。全项目汇总看 **用量看板**；系统健康/告警/冷启动（非项目相关）看 **SRE 看板**。

失败答数 by 项目（哪个项目答得差）
P95 总延迟 by 项目
P95 首字延迟 by 项目（体感）

### 说明
- 每条线 = 一个 `projectId`，由 SEARCH 自动发现，新增项目无需改看板。
- 这些是 **projectId 维度**的指标（`…ByProject`），稀疏、供分组展示；**告警仍盯无维度汇总**（SRE 看板）。
- 成功率/失败率请在本看板对照「成功答数」「失败答数」与 **用量看板** 的提问量自行比较；按项目的比率合成需要逐项目 metric math（项目集合稳定后再加）。
- 单项目阶段每图只有一条线，属正常。
